Under Transactions, tap the slider next to Enable payment note to turn it off.
entries.quote: Turned on by default; tap the slider next to Enable payment note to turn it off.

entries.title: Make the Go app open on total-only (quick) sales
steps: In the Go G2 app, open the More menu and tap Settings.
Under Transactions, turn on Quick sale.
entries.quote: Quick sale. Tap to turn on this option if you don't itemize sales and prefer to enter the total amount for each transaction.

entries.title: Employee cannot key in or scan a card in the Go app
steps: Keying or scanning card details needs a permission.
Go to Settings and select Employee Permissions.
Scroll to Access Sale and select View App permissions.
Find Access Manual Transaction and edit the permission.
entries.quote: Key/Scan card permission. Assign permission to let users key in or scan card details manually.

entries.title: Get a copy of every Go app receipt sent to the owner
steps: In the Go G2 app, open the More menu and tap Settings.
Under Transactions, turn on Carbon copy receipts.
A copy of each receipt after a successful transaction or refund goes to the owner's email address.
entries.quote: Send a carbon copy of each receipt after a successful transaction or refund to the owner's email address.

entries.title: Go G1 app: invoice number length
steps: If Invoice Number is selected in Setup, you can enter up to 12 alphanumeric characters for card transactions.
entries.quote: If selected, enter up to 12 alphanumeric characters for card transactions.

entries.title: Refund a payment in the Clover Go app
steps: Your role needs the Access Register > Refund payments permission.
Tap Orders or Transactions at the bottom of the screen.
Find the transaction and tap it.
Tap Issue Refund.
Select a reason under Refund reason. Reasons must be set up on the dashboard first.
On the Refund Payment screen, tap Confirm Refund, then tap OK.
entries.quote: On the Refund Payment screen, tap Confirm Refund; then tap OK.

entries.title: Send or print a receipt for a past sale in the Go app
steps: Tap Orders or Transactions at the bottom of the screen.
Find the transaction and tap it.
Tap Send Receipt.
Select Email, Text or Print, then tap Done.
entries.quote: Tap the transaction; then tap Send Receipt.

entries.title: Go app cannot print a receipt
steps: Printed receipts in the Go app are only available for revised transactions, for example after issuing a refund.
A Bluetooth printer must be in range.
entries.quote: Printed receipts are only available for revised transactions, for example, issuing refunds, and a Bluetooth printer must be in range.

entries.title: Give a role permission to refund (for the Go app)
steps: Log in to your Clover dashboard.
Select Settings > View all settings.
Under Employees, select Employee Permissions.
Under Access Register, select Edit for the Refund payments permission.
Tick the role to add it to the permission.
Select Save.
entries.quote: Under Access Register, select Edit for Refund payments permission.

entries.title: Find a transaction in the Go G2 app
steps: On the home screen, tap Orders (or Transactions).
Tap the time frame at the top left to set a date range of up to 3 months.
Tap the filter icon to filter by Payments, Voids, Manual refunds or Refunds.
Search by Order ID, Transaction ID, last 4 digits of the card, Invoice # or External ID.
Tap a transaction to view the details.
entries.quote: Search all or filtered transactions by Order ID, Transaction ID, last 4 digits on payment card, Invoice #, or External ID (Go G2).

entries.title: Find a transaction in the Go G1 app
steps: Tap the Menu at the top left and select Orders & Transactions.
Under Orders, select a time frame and sort order.
Scroll to the transaction, or tap the search icon at the top right and enter the last 4 digits of the card.
entries.quote: Select the search icon at the top right and enter the last 4 digits of the payment card used.

entries.title: Open (unpaid) transactions in the Go app
steps: Open transactions are saved transactions that have not been paid.
You can create an order on another Clover device and take the payment in the Go app, or the other way round.
Only the last 30 days (Android) or the last 5 days (iOS) of open transactions can be viewed.
entries.quote: only the last 30-day period (Android) or the last 5 days (iOS) can be viewed.

entries.title: Rename or delete an open transaction in the Go app (iOS)
steps: Open the Clover Go app.
At the top left, tap Menu and select Orders & Transactions.
Tap Open.
Find the transaction.
Swipe left on it.
Tap Rename and enter a new name, or tap Delete.
A deleted transaction cannot be retrieved.
entries.quote: Swipe left on the transaction.

entries.title: Rename or delete an open transaction in the Go app (Android)
steps: Open the Clover Go app.
At the top left, tap Menu and select Orders & Transactions.
Tap Open.
Find and tap the transaction.
Tap Rename and enter a new name, or tap Delete.
A deleted transaction cannot be retrieved.
entries.quote: Note: If you delete a transaction in the app, you cannot retrieve it.

entries.title: How far back the Go app shows completed transactions
steps: You can search completed transactions for the last 7 days, past month, past 3 months, or a date range of up to 3 months.
entries.quote: You can search through completed transactions for the last 7 days, past month, past 3 months, or specify up to a 3-month date range.

entries.title: Closeout (batch) on Clover Go
steps: On the Go home screen, select Closeout to see batch history and the status of each batch.
Batches on Clover Go close automatically.
Manual closeout is only for businesses using Clover touchscreen devices. Closing out manually on a device closes all orders on all Clover devices, including Clover Go.
Owners and admins change closeout settings on the dashboard: Settings > View all settings, under About your business select Closeout settings.
entries.quote: Batches on Clover Go are set to close automatically.

entries.title: Get the closeout report by email (Notification Preferences)
steps: Log in to your Clover dashboard.
Select Settings > View all settings.
Under Business operations, select Notification Preferences.
Select Edit.
Select the checkbox next to email for closeout notifications and select Save.
entries.quote: To get closeout notifications, select the checkbox next to email and select Save.

entries.title: Run a report in the Clover Go app
steps: Open the Clover Go app.
From the More menu, select Reporting.
Select the report you want, for example Sales Overview, Sales Report, Tender and Card Types, Item Sales, Discounts, Taxes or Deposit.
entries.quote: From the More menu, select Reporting.

entries.title: What is in the Go G2 app More menu
steps: Employees, Inventory, Reporting, Closeout and Cash Log.
Card reader (U.S. only), to pair your reader.
Help: help articles, your merchant ID and a Call Me support option (U.S. only).
Settings: app preferences and Log Out.
entries.quote: The More menu contains options to manage your business, pair your card reader (U.S. only), get help, set app preferences, and log out.

entries.title: Change the dates shown on the Go app Home screen
steps: The Home screen shows results for Today by default.
Tap the time frame and select Today, Yesterday, this week or month so far, last 7, 30 or 90 days, or Custom.
entries.quote: By default, the Home screen displays results for Today.

entries.title: No Inventory option in the Go G2 More menu
steps: Inventory is not included with the Payments Plus plan, so it does not appear in the More menu.
entries.quote: Note: Inventory is not included with the Payments Plus plan and doesn't appear in the Go G2 More menu.
entries.note: Plan changes go to client services.

entries.title: Go app shows a blank screen when trying to refund
steps: This happens if an item in the order was changed to an unsupported format, such as variable price.
Change the item back to the supported format.
Log out, then reopen the Clover Go app and log in.
Try the refund again.
entries.quote: To correct the problem and issue a refund, change the item back to the supported format, log out, and then reopen and log in to the Clover Go app.
entries.note: From the Canada edition of the Go troubleshooting article; the US edition carries the same text.

entries.title: Duplicated Transaction Detected (Go app): what Proceed and Cancel do
steps: The message appears when the last four card digits and the amount match a recently completed transaction.
If it is not a duplicate, tap Proceed to continue.
To check first, tap Cancel, then tap Menu > Orders & Transactions to review completed transactions.
entries.quote: To review previously completed transactions before continuing, click Cancel; then tap Menu > Orders & Transactions.

entries.title: Go app: cannot switch to another account
steps: From the login screen, tap Switch User.
At the bottom of the login screen, tap New User.
Enter the email and password used to log in to the Web Dashboard for that account.
If they are not accepted, check or reset them on the Web Dashboard.
entries.quote: At the bottom of the login screen, tap New User.

entries.title: Switch between merchant accounts in the Go app
steps: In the Clover Go app, tap Switch Location.
Under Merchant Accounts, tap the account.
Tap Set as Primary Location to make it the default, or Switch Location for this Session for now only.
Accounts with different email addresses need separate logins.
A newly added account can take up to 7 days to appear.
entries.quote: (Optional) To switch merchants for this session only, tap Switch Location for this Session.

entries.title: Clover Go: Dashboard app keeps logging out: change the timeout
steps: The app logs you out after 1 hour of inactivity by default.
In the Clover Go: Dashboard app, go to More > Settings.
Tap App security & privacy, then tap Inactivity timeout.
Select the auto-logout duration you want.
entries.quote: Tap App security & privacy, and then tap Inactivity timeout.
entries.note: From the UK/Ireland article for the 'Clover Go: Dashboard' app; menu names may differ in the US Go app.

entries.title: Clover Go: Dashboard app: switch to another user
steps: Open the app.
Tap More > Lock screen.
On the Enter passcode screen, select Switch User.
Select the user name and email address.
If the user is not listed, select + User login to add a new user.
entries.quote: On the Enter passcode screen, select Switch User.
entries.note: From the UK/Ireland article for the 'Clover Go: Dashboard' app.

entries.title: Check scanner light is green but checks do not scan
steps: Insert the check straight and do not hold it as it feeds.
Turn off the scanner.
Open the scanner door and gently remove debris.
If it still does not work, contact support.
entries.quote: If your Clover check scanner shows a green light but does not scan checks correctly, try clearing the internal feed path.
entries.note: Clover does not name the devices; the check scanner is an accessory.

entries.title: Check scanner light is blinking or solid red
steps: Turn off the scanner.
Open the scanner door.
Remove debris and clean the scan bars.
Turn on the scanner.
Reinsert the check straight and retry the scan.
If the light stays red, contact support.
entries.quote: If your check scanner light is blinking or solid red, cleaning the scanner usually fixes the issue.

entries.title: Check scanner has no lights on
steps: Check the power adapter is firmly plugged into a wall outlet or power strip.
If using a power strip, make sure it is turned on.
Unplug the power adapter, then plug it back in.
Check the power cable is securely connected to the scanner.
If the light comes on but the scanner still does not work, contact support.
entries.quote: If your check scanner has no lights on and fails to work, check the power connections.

entries.title: Clock in at the start of a shift
steps: Open the Shifts app.
Tap the green clock icon in the bottom-right corner.
If the employee is holding cash sales, tick 'I'm holding my cash sales during this shift'.
Tap Clock In.
entries.quote: Tap the green clock icon in the bottom-right corner.

entries.title: Clock out at the end of a shift
steps: Open the Shifts app.
Tap the red clock icon on the Shifts home screen, or the green Clock Out button when viewing shift details.
If it applies, tick 'I held my cash sales during this shift'.
Tap Clock Out.
entries.quote: Tap the red clock icon on the Shifts app home screen.

entries.title: Employee cannot clock in
steps: Employees can only clock in if they have an employee profile.
Create the profile in the Employees app.
The Starter plan supports up to three employees including the owner or admin.
entries.quote: Employees can only clock in if they have an employee profile.

entries.title: What can be changed about an employee on the device
steps: On the device you cannot edit an employee's name or email address from the Employees app.
You can update the employee's PIN, nickname and role there.
entries.quote: On your device, you cannot edit an employee's name and email address from the Employees app, but you can update the employee's PIN, nickname, and role information.

entries.title: Rapid Deposit: where the Deposit Now option is
steps: Dashboard: on Home, select Get Funds Now.
Clover device: under Rapid Deposit tap Deposit Now, or open the Closeout app, tap the current batch and tap Deposit Now.
Clover Go: under Menu, tap Orders & Transactions, then Deposit Now.
Questions about eligibility, fees or funding go to client services.
entries.quote: Note: If you open the Closeout app, tap on the current batch and then tap Deposit Now.

entries.title: Rapid Deposit has not arrived or Deposit now is missing
steps: Clover says a Rapid Deposit usually arrives within a few minutes and can take up to 30 minutes depending on the bank.
A missing 'Deposit now' link usually means the account is not eligible.
Pass these questions to client services.
entries.quote: Rapid deposit typically deposits funds within a few minutes. This process could take up to 30 minutes, depending on your bank.

entries.title: Notices shown when asking for a Rapid Deposit
steps: Clover lists these notices: collection balance, conditional approval, NACHA hold, funding delay (RPP or ACH delay, minimum reserve) and split funding.
Each means Rapid Deposit is not available on the account for now.
These are account and funding matters for client services.
entries.quote: At times, you might receive a notice when trying to get a Rapid Deposit.

entries.title: Rapid Deposit available funds are less than card sales
steps: Clover explains available funds can be lower than card sales because of a daily limit, the fee, excluded high-value or reviewed transactions, pass-through networks, advances and funding holds.
Funds not available for Rapid Deposit still go through the standard deposit.
Questions go to client services.
entries.quote: Any funds that are not available for Rapid Deposit are still deposited through the standard funding process.

entries.title: Where to see deposits on the dashboard
steps: Log in to your Clover dashboard.
From the left, select Finances > Deposits.
The report shows the current month with the latest deposit at the top. Click a row for the details of that transfer.
Questions about amounts, fees, adjustments or chargebacks go to client services.
entries.quote: From the left, select Finances > Deposits.

entries.title: Closing or pausing the account
steps: Clover says pausing, holding or closing an account has to be done through support, with the Merchant ID or Tax ID ready for verification.
Pass this to client services.
entries.quote: For your security, keep your Merchant ID (MID) or Tax Identification Number (TIN) available for verification.

entries.title: Questions about an equipment lease or rental
steps: Clover's help centre has no lease details: it says to contact support.
Pass lease and rental questions to client services.
entries.quote: To learn more about your lease, you'll need to contact Clover support.

entries.title: Adjusting item prices for a cash discount programme
steps: Clover publishes a table of suggested price mark-ups for each cash discount rate and three ways to change prices (cash discount settings, spreadsheet import, bulk edit on the dashboard).
Rate and programme questions go to client services.
entries.quote: You may want to consider updating your in-store prices to accommodate a cash discount.
